description: This file defines the 'HiringManagerUserRole' class, which extends 'AbstractUserRole' and provides methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs (such as vacancies, candidates, interviews) for a hiring manager in an HR management system. It uses traits for services and implements access control logic based on employee number.

classes.name: HiringManagerUserRole
classes.description: Represents a user role for hiring managers with methods to access related entity IDs based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns lists of entity IDs that the hiring manager has access to, based on entity type.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyIds
methods.description: Fetches vacancy IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Fetches vacancy attachment IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateIds
methods.description: Fetches candidate IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIds
methods.description: Fetches interview IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewAttachmentIds
methods.description: Fetches interview attachment IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIds
methods.description: Fetches candidate history IDs accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Fetches candidate action history IDs accessible to the hiring manager.
